top_story_title: Two unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE zero-days under active exploitation, no fix available
top_story_summary: Security firm watchTowr reported on 26 September that two previously unknown remote code execution vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway are being exploited in the wild. Citrix has not confirmed the flaws and has not published a fix, so there is no fixed release to upgrade to and no CVE identifiers to track yet. Check the Citrix security bulletin page for the advisory and the fixed release when one appears - do not act on version numbers from third parties.
top_actions: Inventory every internet-facing NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway now, with its build, and decide per appliance: take offline, or keep up with access restricted.
Restrict reachability of the management interface (NSIP) and any administrative path to a dedicated management VLAN or out-of-band network; remove it from the internet entirely.
Where the gateway must stay published, put geo/ASN and source-IP conditional access in front of it and enforce phishing-resistant MFA on all remote-access and admin accounts.
Subscribe to the Citrix security bulletin feed and treat the fixed release as an emergency change; do not deploy version numbers reported by third parties.
Prepare the post-patch rotation package in advance: admin credentials, service accounts, device certificates, API keys, and any secrets stored on the appliance.
executive_summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway: two unpatched RCE zero-days exploited in the wild, reported 26 September by watchTowr. Citrix has not confirmed the flaws and no fix exists - exposure reduction is the only control today.
No CVE IDs and no fixed release have been published for the NetScaler flaws. Track the Citrix security bulletin directly and do not act on third-party version claims.
One other item in this window (mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 through WAF bypass) concerns an enterprise application rather than network gear and is not covered here.
key_actions: **Citrix** — Identify all NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances from asset inventory with their running builds, and flag which are reachable from the internet.
**Citrix** — For any appliance that is not business-critical, take it offline until Citrix publishes a fix - this is the only control that removes the exposure.
